mx.teacher_note: A solar cooker cooks equally well in full sunlight and complete darkness.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: With everything else unchanged, the solar panel produces more electricity when less sunlight reaches it.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: A lamp with a charged battery cannot light when sunlight is absent.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: Artificial lighting is never needed at noon, even under very dark clouds.

intelligence.enrichment: Heat and light from the Sun can be used for drying food, providing light, producing electricity through solar panels, and cooking directly with Sun energy. When sunlight is available, its heat and light can be used directly or captured by solar panels; when the Sun is not visible, those sunlight-dependent uses are reduced or must be replaced. The learner correctly applies this rule: Heat and light from the Sun can be used for drying food, providing light, producing electricity through solar panels, and cooking directly with Sun energy. Solar devices work the same whether the Sun is visible or not.
